tools.name: list_claude_models
tools.description: List current Claude API models with their prices in USD per million tokens: input, output, prompt-cache writes (5 min / 1 h), cache reads, and the Batch API discount.

tools.name: estimate_claude_cost
tools.description: Estimate the USD cost of Claude API calls from token counts. Handles prompt caching (cache writes and reads), the Batch API 50% discount and long-prompt pricing. Returns cost per request and in total.

tools.name: compare_claude_models
tools.description: Compare what the same workload costs on every Claude model, cheapest first. Give tokens per request and the number of requests (e.g. per user per month).
